meta.title: DV Compass — your guide to the visa lottery
meta.description: A free tool that works out what moving to the US actually costs and what to do next. No account, and you don't need to have won.

planBar.emptyPrompt: How much do you have? We'll work out how long it lasts

home.title: What does starting in the US actually cost?
home.lead: This site works out the real cost, tells you how many months your money lasts, and orders the steps for you. No account needed.
home.notWonYet: Haven't won yet? Everything here still works. Financial planning is more useful before you win — that's when there's still time to save.
home.phaseNote: The foundation works: both languages, both themes, the glass card, the plan bar, and the data status system. The tools themselves come in Phase 1.

eligibility.title: Am I even eligible?
eligibility.lead: Before anything else: the lottery has three requirements. Know them before you spend time or money.
eligibility.staleWarning: This was last checked on the date shown and some time has passed. The rules change every cycle — check the official page yourself.
eligibility.disclaimer: This site is not legal advice. It explains and organises; the official site is the final word.

planner.title: Money plan
planner.lead: Tell us what you have. We'll tell you how many months it lasts, in which city, and what to do first.
planner.disclaimer: These are estimates based on the site's data, not a promise. This site is not legal or financial advice.
planner.savedLocally: Every answer is saved on your device immediately. No account, no server.
planner.liveUpdate: The plan updates live as you change anything.

money.q: How much do you have in US dollars right now?
money.hint: What will actually be in hand when you land.

moneyIncludesTravel.q: Does that include flights and visa fees?

monthlyIncomeFromHome.q: Will you keep any monthly income from home?
monthlyIncomeFromHome.hint: Remote work, rent, family support — anything steady.

monthlyDebt.q: Do you have debts or monthly commitments?

plannedArrival.q: Roughly when do you plan to travel?
plannedArrival.hint: Completely optional — skip it if you don't know yet.

host.q: Do you know anyone in the US?
host.hint: Somewhere to stay for the first weeks changes the plan a lot.

hostNights.q: How many nights could they host you?

drivingYears.q: How many years have you held a driving licence?

openToPhysicalWork.q: Open to physical work at first?
openToPhysicalWork.hint: There is no wrong answer. It only changes which cities are suggested.

priorities.q: What matters most in your first year?
priorities.hint: Tap in order, most important first.

result.goAlone: With this money, go alone first
result.balanceAria: Projected balance across 12 months under three scenarios
result.unverifiedTitle: Numbers this plan relied on that still need verification
result.unverifiedLead: {count} fields are still unconfirmed. The plan was calculated without them, so the numbers may change once they are filled.

need.lead: Pick the city, the household, and how long you want to last without work — we'll tell you what you need.
need.breakdownHint: That's landing costs plus {months} months of living with no income.
need.unverified: {count} numbers in this calculation still need verification.

timeline.title: The journey map
timeline.lead: From registration to the card arriving. This page opens ready — you don't need to enter anything.
timeline.trackingHint: Optional. Turn it on to mark your stage, add your dates, and export them to your calendar.
timeline.estimateWarning: These durations are estimates and vary a lot by case and by consulate.
timeline.disclaimer: This site is not legal advice. Durations and steps are for orientation; the official site is the reference.

checklist.stepsLead: Every step in order. Tick what's done — progress saves on your device.
checklist.disclaimer: This site is not legal advice.

documents.title: Documents checklist
documents.lead: For each document: why you need it, how long it's valid, and the common mistakes.
documents.prefilled: We filled the filters from your data — you can change them.
documents.disclaimer: This site is not legal advice. Confirm requirements with the consulate itself.

vault.title: Document dates
vault.lead: Record when your documents expire and we'll tell you what's coming up.
vault.localOnly: ⚠️ No file uploads. Names and dates only, stored on your own device — no server receives anything.
vault.disclaimer: This site is not legal advice.

interview.title: Consulate questions
interview.lead: For each question: why it's asked, and what to have ready.
interview.disclaimer: This site is not legal advice, and it does not tell you what to say — it helps you prepare your honest answer.

simulator.title: Interview simulator
simulator.lead: A random question and a time limit. Practise telling the truth clearly.
simulator.honesty: Practising saying the truth clearly and confidently. It does not tell you what to say, and there is nothing here that teaches you to dress up an answer or leave something out. Honesty isn't moral advice here — it's the only safe approach.
simulator.noSpeech: Your browser doesn't support speech capture. You can still use this — read the question, answer out loud, and time yourself.
simulator.selfCheck: Ask yourself: did you answer the question actually asked? And was everything you said true?
simulator.disclaimer: This site is not legal advice.

compareCities.title: Compare cities
compareCities.lead: First question: can I live without a car? That's the biggest line in your first-year budget.
compareCities.carFilter: Can I live without a car?

carLevel.1: Cities needing no car at all

compareCities.disclaimer: These are estimates and they change. Check the source before deciding on them.

compareStates.title: Compare states
compareStates.lead: The state decides taxes, licensing, and the insurance system.
compareStates.cityWarning: ⚠️ Car need, rent, and community are not state data — they're city data. New York State contains New York City (no car needed) and Buffalo (car needed). For those, use the city comparison.
compareStates.disclaimer: This site is not legal or tax advice.

calculators.missingLead: {count} numbers in this calculation still need verification. They were left out — the result may change.
calculators.staleTaxYear: ⚠️ The tax numbers on this site are for {year}. Check them before deciding on anything.

takeHome.title: Take-home pay
takeHome.lead: You've been offered a salary — what actually reaches your hand?
takeHome.povertyLine: Your income is about {pct}% of the federal poverty line.
takeHome.healthHint: A rough pointer to go and ask — not a decision. Medicaid rules differ by state.
takeHome.disclaimer: Estimates, not tax advice. The reference is irs.gov and your state tax authority.

gig.title: Delivery app earnings
gig.lead: The gross the app shows you is not what reaches you.
gig.realHourlyHint: After fuel, depreciation, insurance and tax. This is the only number worth deciding on.
gig.mileageNote: The mileage deduction saved you ${amount} of taxable income.

arrival.title: Landing cost
arrival.lead: Everything you pay on arrival, before any income starts.
arrival.hint: Flights + first month's housing + deposit + setup + food
arrival.prefilled: We filled this from your data — you can change it.
arrival.disclaimer: Estimates based on the site's data.

runway.title: How long your money lasts
runway.lead: The same calculation as the plan, for one city.
runway.disclaimer: Estimates based on the site's data.

car.calcTitle: The true cost of a car
car.calcLead: The price is not the cost. Here's the full calculation, compared against renting one from the app.
car.aprWarningTitle: Interest rates for a new immigrant
car.aprWarning: With no US credit history, your rate will be far higher than anyone else's. That's normal, not an exception — know it before you walk into a dealership, not while you're signing.
car.canDelay: In your city you can delay buying
car.canDelayHint: Transit covers you here. Delaying a purchase by months saves thousands in your first year.
car.neverBreakEven: With these numbers renting wins — buying never breaks even.
